item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The plain evaluation branch uses `Evaluate(...)(program)` with a metric that requires `trace`, and shows that this path fails because `Evaluate.__call__` invokes metrics as `metric(example, prediction)` with no trace argument.","span_ids":["E1"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"The working branch goes through `BootstrapFewShot.compile(...)` with the same metric, and shows that bootstrapping succeeds because `_bootstrap_one_example` runs under `dspy.context(trace=[])`, captures `dspy.settings.trace`, and calls the metric as `metric(example, prediction, trace)`.","span_ids":["E2","E4"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"The success proof checks post-compile state, not just lack of an exception: a successful bootstrap converts recorded trace steps into predictor demos, and `compile()` returns a student with `_compiled = True`.","span_ids":["E3","E4"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"The answer makes the root cause explicit: the mismatch is per-example trace availability, which bootstrap handles internally and `Evaluate` does not.","span_ids":["E5","E1","E2"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"E1","path":"dspy/evaluate/evaluate.py","start_line":170,"end_line":173},{"span_id":"E2","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":187,"end_line":210},{"span_id":"E3","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":223,"end_line":257},{"span_id":"E4","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":84,"end_line":94},{"span_id":"E5","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":178,"end_line":180}]}
